topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got home, and there on my doorstep was a package. Not just any package, one clearly meant for the person who lived here before me. I opened it, hoping, praying it wasn't what I thought. But it was. Old documents, letters, everything still sealed, addressed to someone I don't know. What do I do now? I can't just send it back; it's not that simple. It's late, and I'm exhausted, but the thought of just putting it aside makes me restless. This has to be handled right, but I'm so unsure where to start. Should I call the post office? Try to find the previous tenant myself? Each option feels like a maze with no clear way out.
